fact: In August 2026 the CNDP told political parties to flag any AI-produced content, citing Articles 39, 51 and 53 of Organic Law 53-25 on the Chamber of Representatives and Article 447-2 of the Penal Code; CSCA also barred misleading AI election content from broadcast.
title: Morocco Orders Parties to Follow Data Rules, Flag AI Content Before September 23 Vote
